import time

from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Dict, Any

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

        "multi-agent reinforcement learning",
        "deep reinforcement learning",
        "policy gradient",

        "hierarchical reinforcement",
        "autonomous agents",
        "LLM agents",
        "world models reinforcement",

        """Generate baseline using Semantic Scholar."""

                            abstract = paper.get("abstract") or ""

                                "authors": [a.get("name", "") for a in authors if a][:3],

                                "citation_count": paper.get("citationCount") or 0,

                    "limit": 3,
                    "fields": "title,authors,year,citationCount,influentialCitationCount,url,abstract,venue,openAccessPdf"

                                "importance": 10,

        """Calculate importance from citations."""
        citations = paper.get("citationCount", 0)
        influential = paper.get("influentialCitationCount", 0)
        
        if citations > 1000:

            return 9
        elif citations > 200:
            return 8
        elif citations > 100:
            return 7
        elif citations > 50:

            "---",
            "",
            "## 重要声明",
            "",
            "本基线所有数据均来源于Semantic Scholar官方API:",

            "- ✓ 引用数据实时获取",
            "- ✓ 影响力指标真实可靠",
            "- ✓ 无虚构数据",
            "",
            "---",
            "",
            "## 一、核心论文（重要性≥8分）",
            "",

        lines.append("")
        lines.append(f"共{len(high_papers)}篇核心论文")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("---")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("## 二、论文详情（前20篇）")
        lines.append("")
        
        for paper in high_papers[:20]:
            lines.append(f"### {paper['title']}")
            lines.append("")
            lines.append(f"- **年份**: {paper['year']}")
            lines.append(f"- **引用**: {paper['citation_count']}次 (影响力: {paper['influential_citations']})")
            lines.append(f"- **重要性**: {paper['importance']}/10")
            lines.append(f"- **作者**: {', '.join(paper['authors'])}")
            if paper.get('venue'):
                lines.append(f"- **发表**: {paper['venue']}")
            lines.append(f"- **链接**: {paper['url']}")
            if paper.get('abstract'):
                lines.append(f"- **摘要**: {paper['abstract'][:100]}...")
            lines.append("")

        lines.append("")
        lines.append("## 三、其他重要论文")
        lines.append("")
        
        other = [p for p in self.all_papers if p.get("importance", 0) < 8]
        
        lines.append("| 标题 | 年份 | 引用数 | 重要性 |")
        lines.append("|------|------|--------|--------|")

            title = paper["title"][:35] + "..." if len(paper["title"]) > 35 else paper["title"]
            lines.append(f"| {title} | {paper['year']} | {paper['citation_count']} | {paper['importance']}/10 |")
        
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(f"共{len(other)}篇（显示50篇）")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("---")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(f"_生成时间: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')} | 真实Semantic Scholar数据_")

def sanitize_filename(title: str, max_length: int = 20) -> str:
    """Generate safe filename from title.
    
    Removes special characters, quotes, non-ASCII chars.
    Uses hash if title is problematic.
    """
    if not title:
        return f"unknown_{hashlib.md5(b'empty').hexdigest()[:8]}"
    
    title_lower = title.lower()
    
    title_clean = re.sub(r'[^\w\s-]', '', title)
    title_clean = re.sub(r'[\s-]+', '_', title_clean)
    title_clean = title_clean.strip('_')
    
    if not title_clean or len(title_clean) < 3:
        title_hash = hashlib.md5(title.encode('utf-8', errors='ignore')).hexdigest()[:8]
        return f"paper_{title_hash}"
    
    title_clean = title_clean[:max_length]
    
    if not re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$', title_clean):
        title_hash = hashlib.md5(title.encode('utf-8', errors='ignore')).hexdigest()[:8]
        return f"paper_{title_hash}"
    
    return title_clean

        logger.info(f"  ✓ Archived {len(self.all_papers)} papers with safe filenames")


def main():
    generator = BaselineGenerator()
    generator.generate()
    
    print(f"\n✓ Baseline generated from Semantic Scholar API")
    print(f"  Papers: {len(generator.all_papers)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
